pathway.name: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, and clearance

provenance.checkpoint_scope: Computational import, exact identifier mapping and pathway-workflow QA on externally held human bulk brain results. Does not validate a GBM mechanism, AD mechanism, source statistical model, curated graph claim, or research question.
provenance.source_kind: Public author-posted portfolio reanalysis of a primary human brain RNA-seq cohort; not the original study authors' differential-expression table. Independent scientific review of the portfolio analysis was not established.
provenance.reanalysis_author: Katarzyna Zielińska (GitHub Katarzyna-Zielinska); repository LICENSE identifies copyright (c) 2026 Katja Zielka.

normalized_result.operation: Retain all 37,101 original rows and ordering. Copy blank-header NCBI Gene ID column to gene and retain both supplied statistical strings, including NA. UTF-8 CSV with LF line endings. No mapping, threshold filtering, missing-row deletion, merging, renaming of IDs or recalculation.

model.sample_selection: Exclude LGG, drop unused condition level, subset count columns to metadata Sample, assert sample column ordering.
model.estimation: DESeq(dds); results(dds) with no explicit contrast or lfcShrink call; Healthy is first factor level and GBM second.
model.effect_interpretation: Author-coded GBM relative to Healthy; positive values mean higher modeled RNA in GBM.
model.adjusted_pvalues: Supplied DESeq2 padj fields preserved verbatim. results(dds) default filtering/model not independently rerun; DESeq2 version not recorded in inspected script.
model.ordering: Author script sorts results by padj.
model.annotation_scope: Author script maps NCBI Gene IDs with org.Hs.eg.db using multiVals="first" for displays and significant subset. This extraction does not use those symbols or this potentially lossy annotation.
model.full_csv_export_limit: Inspected script does not explicitly save DESeq2_results_GBM_vs_Healthy.csv. The separately posted full CSV has the exact pretest-filtered identifier family; its significant APOE row exactly matches the separately posted annotated significant-only CSV. No differential-expression statistics were recomputed.

apoe.crosscheck: The separately posted significant-only table explicitly labels NCBI Gene 348 as APOE and supplies identical statistics. It was used only for this identity/statistics crosscheck, never as the tested background.

full_family_independent_audit.method: Apply the posted row-sum>=10 pretest filter to the exact 100 GEO-identified GBM/normal columns of the posted count matrix; compare identifiers only, without running differential expression. All 37,101 retained identifiers match the full result set exactly.

primary_cohort.title: Transcriptome profiling of human glioma and normal brain tissues by rRNA-deleted total RNAseq
primary_cohort.assay: Human bulk brain biopsies, rRNA-depleted stranded total RNA-seq; not cultured cells, single nuclei or pseudobulk.
primary_cohort.n_scope: GEO sample/biopsy counts confirmed in the series matrix. Unique donor count or paired design was not independently established.
primary_cohort.primary_reported_processing: GEO describes RNA isolation with RNeasy or Trizol, Illumina stranded total RNA TruSEQ, HiSeq4000, HISAT2 2.1.0 GRCh38 alignment, HTSeq-count 0.10.0 and DESeq2 1.20.0 normalization. This describes the original cohort, not a verified generation pipeline for the portfolio's NCBI-named count matrix.
primary_cohort.count_matrix_generation_limit: The portfolio filename identifies GRCh38.p13/NCBI counts. Its generation procedure, exact annotation release, mapping/version assignment and relation to original authors' HTSeq counts were not independently reconstructed.

primary_publication.title: PRMT6 methylation of RCC1 regulates mitosis, tumorigenicity, and radiation response of glioblastoma stem cells
inspected_locations: Method Details: Bioinformatic Analyses of PRMT6 Expression
primary_publication.cohort_provenance: Inspected methods connect Northwestern NSTB clinical glioma specimens and NIH NeuroBioBank normal brain tissue specimens to supplementary Table S3 and GSE147352. The paper also includes cultured cells and mice; those experiments are not this observational tissue comparison.
primary_publication.supplement_limit: Table S3 is a PRMT-family expression/clinical table, not a full DEG family. Supplement full text and underlying raw differential-expression model were not exhaustively reanalyzed.

reuse.underlying_data_redistribution_rights: Not independently established. MIT Software/documentation terms are not treated as a blanket relicense of third-party cohort data or publication content. Experimental source/normalized/count tables stay outside Git and the hosted app.
reuse.publication_reuse: PubMed reports Elsevier Inc. 2021 all rights reserved; accessible NIH author manuscript was inspected, without republication of article text or supplementary data.
reuse.attribution: Credit portfolio reanalysis and original Huang et al. cohort/GSE147352 separately. Do not attribute portfolio statistics to the original publication.

interpretation_limits: Observational brain-tumor versus nonmalignant tissue comparison. Tumor cells, immune infiltration, glial abundance, tissue handling and other composition effects can contribute to bulk RNA differences.
The source model includes Condition only; age, sex, tumor subtype/IDH status, collection/processing and other potential confounders are not adjusted in the inspected model.
Unresolved or ambiguous current HGNC cross-references must remain in the eligible denominator and retain original NCBI IDs; no alias repair or upstream multiVals="first" mappings are adopted.
The AD human-paper interpretation catalog provides general context only; it does not explain or validate this GBM case or establish a shared mechanism.
No protein abundance, pathway activity, causation, novelty, replication or researcher approval follows from numerical/browser agreement.
verification: Preparation and --check succeed on exact pinned source.
Independent CSV comparison verifies every original ID/statistical string and order is retained, including all 1,441 NA rows.
Same-size altered input is rejected before creating output.
Altered output --check is rejected and leaves bytes unchanged.
Python syntax compilation succeeds without installing dependencies.

interpretation_scope: A real input exercises the rule-based report. The selected lipoprotein pathway has q > 0.05; the report is triggered by selected APOE and explicit context, not enrichment significance. Existing AD paper premises are context, not explanations validated for GBM. The graph is unchanged.
